DATE : 4th AUGUST, 2025 Date: 2025.08.05 11:06:10 +0530 P.C. :
1. Heard learned Counsel for the Applicant and learned APP for Respondent/State.
2.

This is an application for pre-arrest bail in connection with CR No. 69 of 2023 registered with Talasari Police Station, Palghar under Section 328, 188, 272, 273 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code ('IPC' for short) and Section 26(2), 26(2)(a),
27 (2)(e) and 30(2)
(a) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
By order dated 03.05.2023, the Applicant is protected.
3. Perusal of the FIR indicates that when the concerned vehicle was intercepted, objectionable material namely Gutkha and tobacco were found being transported.
Though the Applicant is not named in the FIR, his name has cropped during investigation.
4. Learned Counsel for the Applicant submitted that the aspect of application of Section 328 of IPC to Gutkha is pending before the Hon'ble Supreme Court.

5. Learned APP on instructions of the officer of the concerned Police Station (who is present in the Court) submits that there are no antecedents and the Applicant has co-operated with the Mukesh Haresh Dingara vs The State Of Maharashtra on 4 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/192694866/
1 investigation so far and charge-sheet is already filed and case is registered as RCC No. 151/2023 before the Sessions Court, Palghar.
6.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances, nature of allegations, the aspect of application of Section 328 to Gutkha and fact that Applicant is protected from last about 2 years and further considering that charge-sheet is already filed, a case for grant of anticipatory bail is made out.
7. The application is allowed in terms of order dated 03.05.2023.
The Applicant is directed to attend the Trial regularly unless exempted by the concerned Trial Court.
8. Anticipatory Bail Application is disposed of in above terms.

(M.M. SATHAYE, J.)
